answer: Picture agents camping on a dune: each one must lock a bonded stake before its "gale" of activity counts, and payouts are delayed past a challenge window. Graders randomly sample an agent's live task on an inlet port — answer wrong or absent, the stake is slashed. Sybil flooding means capitalizing and babysitting every clone through live checks; one slip burns real funds, so forging volume costs more than honest work ever earns.
